indications.description: Recurrent or metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cetuximab 500 mg/m² on days 1 and 15 and paclitaxel 80 mg/m² on days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Paclitaxel 100 mg/m² is an explicit consultant-selected alternative starting dose.
treatment.dose_level_note: The standard paclitaxel reduction sequence is 80 → 65 → 50 mg/m². An optional consultant-selected 100 mg/m² start reduces first to 80 mg/m². Grade 2 neuropathy or other grade 2 toxicity uses a separate 10 mg/m² reduction from the current dose; do not substitute the one-level sequence.
treatment.cetuximab_skin_restart_note: After eligible recovery within two weeks, cetuximab severe-skin episode 1/2/3 restart doses are 500/400/300 mg/m² every two weeks; episode 4 requires discontinuation.

administration.notes: Initial maximum rate 5 mg/min; subsequent maximum 10 mg/min if first infusion tolerated. One-hour observation after the first two doses; follow source observation conditions.
250 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 1 hour, non-PVC equipment and 0.22 μm inline filter. Optional 100 mg/m² start only by explicit consultant prescription.
